spanish: Toda la minjá que acercarán a Jehová no será hecha leudado, porque toda levadura y toda miel no harán humear desde ella ofrenda de fuego a Jehová.

findings.issue: Common noun (H4503) left as the untranslated lemma minjá.
Suffix is 1st common plural; desde ella is 3rd feminine singular.
Masculine noun rendered as the participle leudado, which can read as an adjective.

notes: 2mp acercarán and harán humear match ustedes address.
